meal.title: Add two integers
meal.objective: Perform addition on two integer variables and store the result

voice.script: What happens when you add two numbers in code? How do you store the sum of two integers? You already have two integer variables holding values. The addition operator, a plus sign, tells Python to calculate the total of those values. So we write a new variable called total and assign it the sum of the first two variables. This line performs the addition and stores the result. When the program runs, it prints the total so you can see the answer. The flow looks like: start, read numbers, add them, display result, end. Remember: the plus sign adds two integers and gives a new integer. Now try changing the numbers and see a different sum.
